notes.title: GUNSMITH SIMULATOR – FLINT & POWDER – RELEASE DATE: JANUARY 9, 2025!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37121359/81150ca7390533b1c6e8736ace0274c528835e23.png[/img]

Dear Gunsmiths,

We are thrilled to announce that the highly anticipated DLC for our game, [b]Gunsmith Simulator: Flint & Powder, will debut on January 9, 2025! [/b]This brand-new adventure in the world of firearms will allow you to explore five new black powder-era guns. The DLC promises fantastic gameplay while expanding your collection and enhancing your gunsmithing skills.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288480/Gunsmith_Simulator__Flint__Powder/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101120/Gunsmith_Simulator/

If you haven’t already, make sure to add Gunsmith Simulator: Flint & Powder to your Steam wishlist to receive a reminder about the release and not miss this unique opportunity!

Finally, we wish you a Happy New Year 2025! May the coming year bring you even more success, satisfaction, and unforgettable adventures in the world of Gunsmith Simulator!

See you in the workshop!

notes.title: New update: Makarov is here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37121359/7a295a3e2b90b5597d63f453156dae8296daeb42.png[/img]

Hello, Gunsmiths!

We come to you with exciting news! In the latest update to Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue, a new weapon has been introduced - Makarov.

Makarov is a Russian semi-automatic pistol that uses 9x18mm Makarov ammunition. This compact pistol was first introduced in 1951 and has since gained popularity among the Russian armed forces and many other countries. Its simple design, reliability and unique features make it highly favored among firearm enthusiasts.

We’d also like to remind you that the Early Access version of the game will be released very soon, offering even more weapons and thrilling challenges. You'll experience the joy of being true gunsmiths, working in your own workshop. You'll have the opportunity to repair, restore former glory and modify various types of weapons, creating unique pieces that will catch the attention of every enthusiast.

Mark the date in your calendar - July 19th - and don't forget to add the game to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101120/Gunsmith_Simulator/

See you in the workshop!

notes.title: Update of Gunsmith SImulator: Prologue. Fixed bugs!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37121359/5357f6d2ad8a95a4d1f63aece8d3eaaf5311c5dc.png[/img]

Hello, Gunsmiths!

We’ve prepared a brief summary of our work on fixing bugs in our game Gunsmith Simulator: Prologue since its release. Thanks to the intensive efforts of our developers, we’ve managed to fix a few bugs that appeared at this stage. Below is a l[b]ist of the fixed bugs:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Fixes in text localization.
[*] Change preventing using a profile name that would break path for saving the game.
[*] Separate setting for enabling or disabling motion blur.
[*] Enabling VSync automatically disables frame rate target.
[*] Default frame rate target set to 60, more options for frame rate targets.
[/olist]
We’d also like to [b]thank you for all the feedback you’ve provided us.[/b] Without your help, we wouldn’t have been able to introduce so many fixes in such a short time since the release!

We hope that these fixes will allow you to enjoy smoother gameplay and that no more bugs will appear!

GameHunters
